readinessStages.worldText: The chorus hears you, but the bridge is still learning your rhythm.
The seed-signal bridge is warming. Growth and memory are beginning to separate into paths.
The chorus has tuned. A fork of bloom and residue is forming inside the host tissue.
Pulse the warmed bridge and let the next choice become matter.
